preJs: (async () => { const eye = [-8.3, 1.75, 4.8]; __sdfGame.setPose(-8.3, 4.8, Math.PI/2, 0); const zs = __sdfGame.zombies().filter(z => z.room === 4); let far = null, fx = -1e9; for (const z of zs) { if (z.pos[0] > fx) { fx = z.pos[0]; far = z; } } if (!far) throw new Error('no room-4 body'); const cl = __sdfGame.zombie(far.id).posed().clusters.find(c => c.limb === 'torso'); if (!cl) throw new Error('no torso'); const c = cl.center; const toEye = [eye[0]-c[0], eye[1]-c[1], eye[2]-c[2]]; const L = Math.hypot(toEye[0],toEye[1],toEye[2]); const surf = [c[0]+toEye[0]/L*0.25, c[1]+toEye[1]/L*0.25, c[2]+toEye[2]/L*0.25]; const dx = surf[0]-eye[0], dy = surf[1]-eye[1], dz = surf[2]-eye[2]; const yaw = Math.atan2(dx, -dz), pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx,dz)); __sdfGame.setPose(-8.3, 4.8, yaw, pitch); const pred = __sdfGame.predictSlugHit(); if (pred.actorId !== far.id) { __sdfGame.setPose(-8.3, 4.8, Math.PI/2, 0); throw new Error('predict hit actor '+pred.actorId+' want '+far.id); } const ok = __sdfGame.fireSlug(); let wc = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); wc = __sdfGame.zombie(far.id).woundCount(); if (wc > 0) break; } const torsoStill = !!__sdfGame.zombie(far.id).posed().clusters.find(cc => cc.limb === 'torso'); __sdfGame.setPose(-8.3, 4.8, Math.PI/2, Math.atan2(1.2-1.75, 8)); if (!ok || wc < 1 || !torsoStill) throw new Error('slug staging failed ok='+ok+' wc='+wc+' torso='+torsoStill); const w = __sdfGame.debugWounds(far.id); const r3 = __sdfGame.zombies().filter(z => z.pos[0] >= 0.8).map(z => [z.id, z.pos.map(v=>+v.toFixed(1))]); return { farId: far.id, farPos: far.pos.map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), dist: +Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz).toFixed(2), wounds: wc, woundAt: w.map(x=>x.surface.map(v=>+v.toFixed(2))), room3Bodies: r3 }; })()
